results.title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
results.original_title: ธี่หยด: สมิงเขาขวาง
results.overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.

results.title: The Debt Collector
results.original_title: คนเดือดทวงแค้น
results.overview: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

results.title: Ong-Bak
results.original_title: องค์บาก
results.overview: When the head of a statue sacred to a village is stolen, a young martial artist goes to the big city and finds himself taking on the underworld to retrieve it.

results.title: My Dearest Assassin
results.original_title: เลือดรักนักฆ่า
results.overview: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

results.title: The Medium
results.original_title: ร่างทรง
results.overview: A shaman's family learn that their goddess is supposedly controlling one of them. However, their lives take a frightening turn when they realise the goddess has nothing to do with the possession.

results.title: Morte Cucina
results.original_title: ครัวสาว
results.overview: Sao, a talented cook, accidentally meets the man who took advantage of her in the past. She sets her revenge plan in motion using her cooking skill to achieve a rather unexpected result.

results.title: The 8th Day
results.original_title: แปดวัน แปลกคน
results.overview: A mysterious story set in a run-down house where an eccentric elderly lady lives alone. One day, a little girl steps inside the house and never comes back. The girl seems to be locked inside the house for 8 days. No one knows what is going on in the house except for a young doctor who witnesses everything.

results.title: Death Whisperer 2
results.original_title: ธี่หยด 2
results.overview: Three years after his sister's death, Yak relentlessly searches for the dark spirit that killed her in hopes of seeking revenge.

results.title: Blue Territory
results.original_title: Blue Territory
results.overview: An old house is crumbling. An architect fixes it with blue powder paint -- but it's a hopeless endeavour as he tries to salvage what's already destroyed.

results.title: How to Make Millions Before Grandma Dies
results.original_title: หลานม่า
results.overview: M, a university dropout low on money and luck, volunteers to take care of his terminally ill grandmother, in the hope of pocketing an inheritance.

results.title: In the Name of Love
results.original_title: อัศจรรย์วันทอง
results.overview: Follows a modern-day writer who slips back in time, inhabiting the body of Wanthong from the Thai classic Khun Chang Khun Phaen, and struggles to rewrite her destiny and avoid a tragic fate.

results.title: Shutter
results.original_title: ชัตเตอร์ กดติดวิญญาณ
results.overview: When Jane and Tun run over a girl in a car accident, they speed away immediately from the crime scene. However, Tun, a photographer, soon discovers strange shadows in his photos, which unsettles them.

results.title: The Protector
results.original_title: ต้มยำกุ้ง
results.overview: A young fighter named Kham must go to Australia to retrieve his stolen elephant. With the help of a Thai-born Australian detective, Kham must take on all comers, including a gang led by an evil woman and her two deadly bodyguards.

results.title: Bangkok Breaking: Heaven and Hell
results.original_title: Bangkok Breaking: ฝ่านรกเมืองเทวดา
results.overview: When a dedicated rescue worker inadvertently gets caught up in the kidnapping plot of a mogul's tween daughter, he must save her from the clutches of rival gangs hunting them down with unpredictable dangers around every corner.

results.title: Ong Bak 2
results.original_title: องค์บาก 2
results.overview: Tien, the son of Lord Sihadecho — a murdered nobleman — is taken under the wing of Chernang, a renowned warrior and leader of the Pha Beek Krut.

results.title: The Red Line
results.original_title: เส้นตาย สายลวง
results.overview: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money — and their dignity.

results.title: MATE
results.original_title: เพื่อนสัมพันธ์
results.overview: Roommates who are far more than just roommates must confront the unspoken feelings they've kept buried inside.

results.title: How to Win at Checkers (Every Time)
results.original_title: พี่ชาย My Hero
results.overview: An 11-year-old boy steals money for bribes to remove his gay older brother from Thai military conscription rolls, unaware of the ramifications.

results.title: Death Whisperer
results.original_title: ธี่หยด
results.overview: When a remote village is plagued by a deadly curse, one brother must fight to save his family from a terrifying supernatural threat.

results.title: Bang
results.original_title: ปัง
results.overview: Follows a ruthless hitman who, after narrowly escaping a fatal attempt on his life, betrays his gang in an effort to find forgiveness but ends up becoming a target himself.
